## Description {#details}

<p>Represents a literal operand in a bitcode record.</p>


<p>The value of a literal operand is the same for all instances of the record, so it is only emitted in the abbreviation definition.</p>


<p>Note that because this uses a compile-time template, you cannot have a literal operand that is fixed at run-time without dropping down to the raw LLVM APIs.</p>


<p>Definition at line 64 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/bitcode/bitcodeconvenience-h">BitcodeConvenience.h</a>.</p>
